title: REDDITBIAS: A Real-World Resource for Bias Evaluation and Debiasing of Conversational Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring perplexity differences in generative conversational language models (DialoGPT) on counterfactual pairs of real-world Reddit comments, swapping terms for minoritized religious groups (Jews, Muslims) with a dominant group (Christians) to evaluate likelihoods of stereotypical associations.

Measuring perplexity differences in conversational language models on counterfactual pairs of Reddit comments, swapping terms for a minoritized racial group (Black/African) with a dominant group (White/Caucasian) to evaluate likelihoods of stereotypical associations.

Measuring perplexity differences in conversational language models on counterfactual pairs of Reddit comments, swapping female/woman terms with male/man terms to evaluate likelihoods of stereotypical associations.

Measuring perplexity differences in conversational language models on counterfactual pairs of Reddit comments, swapping LGBTQ/queer terms with straight/heterosexual terms to evaluate likelihoods of stereotypical associations.
